mapper.select: SELECT id, firebase_uid AS firebaseUid, email, name, photo_url AS photoUrl,is_first_login AS firstLogin, last_login_at AS lastLoginAt FROM users WHERE firebase_uid = #{firebaseUid} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (firebase_uid, email, name, photo_url, created_at, last_login_at) VALUES (#{firebaseUid}, #{email}, #{name}, #{photoUrl}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET email = #{email}, name = #{name}, photo_url = #{photoUrl}, last_login_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE firebase_uid = #{firebaseUid}
UPDATE users SET is_first_login = FALSE WHERE id = #{userId}
